# BCGov Crow - v0.12.4

## Release type

Patch release

## Summary

Crow Testing makes property-based test failures easier to replay while keeping
normal runs exploratory. It also clarifies how project-specific feature
scenarios and recurring manual checks are organized and reviewed.

## Highlights

- CsCheck examples use a per-test `ReplaySeed` local to replay a reported
  failure in isolation; a trailing guard catches seeds accidentally left in
  normal tests.
- Scenario planning follows confirmed application and feature ownership.
  Manual QA guidance keeps a single browse/release index with linked,
  tester-facing checks and explicit review status.

## Changes

- Documented how to reproduce a failed property test in Test Explorer or with
  a filtered `CsCheck_Seed` run, and how to retain the discovered case as a
  regression test without narrowing future exploratory runs.
- Clarified the nullable-reference prerequisite, the `CsCheck_Time` override,
  and the intentionally relative date generators in the .NET testing guidance.
- Aligned scenario-organization and manual-QA templates with stable check IDs,
  application/page-specific index links, and approval rules for existing
  manual details.

## Validation

- Crow asset validation: Passed with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
- Package dry run: Passed; 222 files selected.
- Archive inspection: Not run; no release archive has been generated for this draft.
- Additional checks: Crow release guards, PR version checks, reviewed-note

## Installation

Install the tagged release globally:

```powershell
apm install bcgov/crow#v0.12.4 --global --target copilot
```

Or install the packaged archive:

```powershell
apm install .\build\bcgov-crow-0.12.4.zip --global --target copilot
```
